narr: A few strong to severe storms developed right along the Palmer Divide in northern El Paso County during the afternoon of August 15th. As the storms slowly drifted east-southeast they became severe producing large damaging hail and pockets of flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding with water flowing over the road at the intersection of Sweet Rd. and Peyton Hwy.
